text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No specific antidotes for ONGENTYS are known. As a general measure, removal of ONGENTYS by gastric lavage and/or inactivation by administering activated charcoal should be considered. In managing overdose, provide supportive care, including close medical supervision and monitoring, and consider the possibility of multiple drug involvement. If an over-exposure occurs, call your poison control center at 1-800-222-1222 or www.poison.org.
